restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 642bf959, 80000000. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 56 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_56(M(x))) XOR q with published q=f47918f944b7c6574bc41883a51dec475f9d2e0de08ed23221cefee63d29ffcb. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=4240. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181912060438479 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 46.63139.
Peak memory is 1048574 bytes; setup peaks at 767282 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 aa045f6614b324b4a808b254909fb70c2ea0a0c78be751daddedec348df18fce; stripped wasm SHA-256 35e7b012b9c04c4bc32343c5057b6e7ca92c7162df4b68085d67d9ff55e859c3; emitted SLP SHA-256 0c4f8b4563a07ab290c173540e21711033c6ec9ffc84caaa55c48add4cde5664. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r56-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections, and compare fixed width-20 and width-22 projections with shared-function random-mapping ensembles. The fourfold state-space change checks persistence only. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
